explication: Watt Toolkit is a cross-platform desktop game utility whose default plugins provide network acceleration, account switching, game-library management, and local authenticators. The visible UI exposes feature pages and settings; the accelerator plugin has a separate reverse-proxy process, certificate support, and script management. The README documents several capabilities whose implementation is not in the sampled excerpts, so those are represented by their exact enclosing plugin directories. Connections between UI and plugin services are not asserted where the excerpts do not show the wiring.
